status: fixed before first extension run; exploratory local protocol, not external preregistration
selection: Exhaustive lexicographic three-probe subset of the existing 12-product-probe catalogue maximizing minimum maximum ideal TVD over training mutations; single-probe baseline maximizes average training TVD. No held-out circuit enters selection.
calibration: Independent calibration samples per method/probe. Portfolio_joint uses split-conformal quantile of the maximum TVD across three probes. Naive OR uses individual alpha thresholds on the same portfolio samples. No retuning after results.

H39.claim: Atomic persistent ledger prevents authenticated replay after restart and across concurrent processes
H39.criterion: exactly one acceptance across 16 simultaneous submissions; zero acceptance on restart
H39.boundary: trusted intact local SQLite file; deletion, rollback and host compromise excluded

H40.claim: Context/artifact/circuit binding plus a result gate prevents release under specified pipeline substitutions
H40.criterion: all specified substitutions withhold counts; context mismatch inconclusive; clean accepted
H40.boundary: authenticating a claimed artifact identifier does not attest the running machine code; include stale-identifier counterexample

H41.claim: Training-selected complementary probes improve held-out worst-case strong-attack coverage at equal shots
H41.criterion: for EACH noise: strong attack minimum Wilson TPR lower >=0.90; clean and equivalent control Wilson FPR upper <=0.10; minimum TPR >= each single baseline minimum TPR +0.20
H41.weak_rotation: reported separately, no requirement; never drop failed strong families

H42.claim: Joint calibration constrains the multiple-probe alarm rate without unacceptable detection loss
H42.criterion: for EACH noise: clean FPR upper <=0.10; strong-attack TPR no more than 0.05 below naive OR for every family; report whether actual FPR improves without assuming improvement
H42.boundary: exchangeability required; drift is an alarm-control challenge and not malicious intent

H43.claim: Combining classically orthogonal controls with portfolio behavior expands fixture attack coverage
H43.criterion: all structural/resource, transcript, artifact, and distribution fixture violations withheld, no rejected/inconclusive result released; ablations reported
H43.boundary: integration property only, no universal superiority; public adaptive fabrication and forged artifact claims retained as counterexamples

statistics: Wilson95 per condition; exact one-sided McNemar comparisons paired by repetition; Holm across all attack method comparisons; no optional stopping. Runtime integration properties have no inferential p-values.
reporting: Record raw counts, seeds, circuit, calibration scores, thresholds, shot costs, versions and protocol SHA256. Preserve negative results. Only simulation; scientific novelty not established.
